tools.name: generate_certificates
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to make certificates: a certificate of completion, an award certificate, a certificate of appreciation or participation, or certificates for a whole class or team from a list of names. Returns one print-ready landscape PDF (US Letter or A4) with one certificate per perso

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_certificates · Public sink: generate_certificates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_certificates · Public sink: generate_certificates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
